item.title: Russia Abandons Key Island Near Kherson, Ukraine
item.description: Ukrainian forces destroyed the Konkivskyi bridge just north of Oleshky on March 15, 2025, severing a critical Russian supply route and forcing enemy units to abandon observation posts on Oleksiivskyi Island under sustained artillery and drone pressure. #WarrenGray #Russia #Ukraine #War #SOFREP #MSN

item.title: Stop Apologizing for Being in the Room: A Simple Rule for People Who Say Sorry Too Much
item.description: The difference between shrinking and expanding in a room often comes down to whether you frame yourself as a burden requiring forgiveness or as someone offering value worth acknowledging. #TeganBroadwater #musician #WhenToSaySorry #MSN #SOFREP #Storytelling

item.title: When Moral Instincts Meet Constitutional Limits: What America Owes-and What It Must Own-in Iran
item.description: We must distinguish between the moral instinct to care about oppression and the strategic decision to use military force, because starting wars requires clear answers about how they end—not just why they begin. #Iran #OpEd #SOFREP #MSN #MilitaryAction #Constitutionality

item.title: Evening Brief: Benghazi Suspect Brought to US for Prosecution, Dozens Killed in Pakistan Mosque Attack, Trump in Hot Water After His Social Media Account Depicts Obamas as Apes
item.description: From a Benghazi suspect finally landing in U.S. custody, to a suicide bomber turning Friday prayers in Islamabad into a massacre, to a president amplifying imagery many see as overtly racist, the throughline is stark and uncomfortable, justice can arrive late, violence arrives fast, and the political temperature keeps rising no matter the cost. #EveningBrief #Trump #Obamas #Apes #SOFREP #Benghazi #MSN
